mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id, groups_id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, product_type, ask_complete_time, complete_time, status, issue_status, user_id, order_number, quantity, print_quantity
mapper.select:
SELECT tr.id orderId, tr.create_time scheduleTime, tr.order_number orderNumber, s.`name` userName, cut.`name` materialTypeName, mp.`name` workshopName, ml.`name`productionLineName, tr.quantity taskQuantity, tr.print_quantity printQuantity, IFNULL( SUM( task.task_quantity * ta.net_weight ), 0 ) taskMete, tr.ask_complete_time completeTime FROM `mes_building_task_order` tr LEFT JOIN sys_user s ON s.id = tr.user_id AND s.bool_delete_enum = false LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON task.task_order_id = tr.id AND task.bool_delete_enum = false LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON ta.id = task.product_id AND ta.bool_delete_enum = false LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mp ON mp.id = task.workshop_id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = false LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line ml ON ml.id = task.production_line_id AND ml.bool_delete_enum = false AND ml.bool_enabled_enum = true LEFT JOIN mes_building_cut_config cut ON cut.id=tr.cut_config_id AND cut.bool_delete_enum=FALSE WHERE tr.bool_delete_enum = false AND tr.task_type_enum = 1
AND tr.project_id = #{projectId}
AND tr.print_quantity>0
AND tr.print_quantity=0
AND mp.id= #{workshopId}
AND date_format(tr.create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{localDateTime}, '%Y-%m')
AND tr.order_number like concat('%', #{orderNumber}, '%')
AND tr.id IN( SELECT a.task_order_id FROM mes_building_task_process a LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b ON b.id = a.process_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.task_type_enum = 1
AND date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{localDateTime}, '%Y-%m')
AND b.type = 8 )
GROUP BY tr.id, ml.`name`, mp.`name`
SELECT b.id FROM mes_building_task_order a LEFT JOIN mes_building_machine_part_scheduling b ON b.id = a.scheduling_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.task_type_enum = 1 AND a.id = #{orderId}

SELECT sep.nest_cut_id cutId, IFNULL( sum( sep.quantity ), 0 ) quantity, IFNULL( sum( sep.quantity * par.net_weight ), 0 ) mete FROM mes_building_nest_cut_machine_part_separate sep LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part par ON sep.product_id = par.id WHERE sep.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND sep.nest_cut_id IN
#{item}
AND sep.process_type = 8 GROUP BY sep.nest_cut_id

SELECT task_order.id, task_order.production_line_id AS groups_id, task_order.project_id, task_order.monomer_id, task_order.task_type_enum, task_order.complete_time, task_order.ask_complete_time, task_order.STATUS, task_order.user_id, task_order.order_number, task_order.quantity, task_order.print_quantity, task_order.cut_config_id, task_order.scheduling_id, task_order.top_task_order_id, task_order.production_line_type_enum, task_order.artifact_date_time, task_order.bool_nest_cut_enum, task_order.create_time, task_order.update_time, task_order.bool_delete_enum, task_order.version, workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.`name` 'workshop.name', workshop.`type` 'workshop.type', production_line.id 'production_line.id', production_line.`name` 'production_line.name' FROM mes_building_task_order task_order LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task_order.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = production_line.workshop_id WHERE task_order.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND (task_order.top_task_order_id = #{topTaskOrderId} AND task_order.complete_time IS NULL) ORDER BY task_order.task_type_enum DESC;

SELECT a.id 'productId', SUM( IFNULL( a.pprocess, 0 ) + IFNULL( b.aprocess, 0 ) )>= 1 'boolenProcess' FROM ( SELECT plink.artifact_id id, SUM( par.bool_process ) pprocess FROM tech_artifact_machine_part_link plink LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part par ON plink.machine_part_id = par.id AND par.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE plink.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND plink.artifact_id IN
#{productId}
GROUP BY plink.artifact_id ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT detail.artifact_id id, SUM( ass.bool_process ) aprocess FROM tech_assemble_detail detail LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass ON detail.assemble_id = ass.id AND ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE detail.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND detail.artifact_id IN
#{productId}
GROUP BY detail.artifact_id ) b ON a.id = b.id GROUP BY a.id

SELECT * FROM mes_building_task WHERE task_order_id IN ( SELECT id FROM mes_building_task_order WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND top_task_order_id IN (SELECT top_task_order_id FROM mes_building_task_order WHERE id = (SELECT task_order_id FROM mes_building_task task WHERE task.id = #{taskId})) AND task_type_enum = 2 ) AND product_id IN (SELECT artifact_id FROM tech_assemble_detail WHERE assemble_id = (SELECT product_id FROM mes_building_task task WHERE task.id = #{taskId})) AND complete_quantity!=task_quantity

SELECT * FROM mes_building_task WHERE id IN ( SELECT task_id FROM mes_building_machine_part_scheduling_artifact_task_link WHERE scheduling_link_id =( SELECT id FROM mes_building_machine_part_scheduling_link WHERE scheduling_id =( SELECT machine_part_scheduling_id FROM mes_building_task WHERE id = #{taskId} ) AND product_id =( SELECT product_id FROM mes_building_task WHERE id = #{taskId} ) )) AND task_type_enum=2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_building_task_order WHERE DATE( create_time )= (DATE(#{now})) and task_type_enum=#{type}

select distinct orde.* from mes_building_task_order orde left join mes_building_groups_team_link link on orde.groups_id = link.groups_id left join mes_building_team_user_link tulink on link.team_id = tulink.team_id left join mes_building_team team on tulink.team_id = team.id where orde.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.user_id = #{userId} and team.process_id = #{processId}

SELECT detail.artifact_id productId, SUM( ass.bool_process ) boolenProcess FROM tech_assemble_detail detail LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass ON detail.assemble_id = ass.id AND ass.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE detail.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND detail.artifact_id IN
#{productId}
GROUP BY detail.artifact_id

SELECT DISTINCT area_id FROM mes_building_task WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND task_type_enum = 2 AND project_id IN
#{projectId}

SELECT task_order_id id, SUM( task_quantity ) taskQuantity, SUM( complete_quantity ) completeQuantity
FROM mes_building_task WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
AND task_order_id IN
#{oderId}
GROUP BY task_order_id
